semgrep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Semgrep
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
          -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/src" \
          semgrep/semgrep:latest \
            semgrep scan \
            --config=auto \
            --exclude=node_modules \
            --exclude=.env \
            --error \
            /src
